facts.snippet: on 26 June, I hosted a day-long workshop focused on collaborative living arrangements among older women
facts.did: 1998 年自撰广告发出后，于 6 月 26 日主持为期一天的工作坊，议题是老年女性的合作居住安排

facts.snippet: I travelled to the USA, Canada, Denmark and Holland, in pursuit of women who had created social groups
facts.did: 取得 Joseph Rowntree Foundation 研究资助后，赴美国、加拿大、丹麦、荷兰寻访已自建互助群体的老年女性

facts.snippet: So, the Older Women’s Cohousing group was born. Otherwise known by its acronym OWCH
facts.who: 八名女性（含 Shirley Meredeen、Madeleine Levius）
facts.did: 在工作坊约一个月后于 Shirley 北伦敦的公寓开首次正式会议，成立 OWCH，决定自己掌控晚年居住

facts.snippet: a capital grant to Housing for Women which enabled us to protect the eight tenancies
facts.did: 在最后关头向 Housing for Women 提供资本拨款，保住八套社会租赁住房名额

facts.snippet: The CEO of Hanover said, ‘OK, great, then let me help you find the site.’
facts.who: Hanover 房屋协会首席执行官
facts.did: 听 Maria 说“我手上就有一个群体”后主动提出帮忙找地，最终在 High Barnet 找到旧校舍场地

facts.snippet: which was then postponed eight times, leaving many of them effectively homeless
facts.did: 把完工日期先后延期八次，使已卖房或退租的成员一度实际无家可归

facts.snippet: When the moment finally came for everyone to move in, they had to do so gradually, one at a time
facts.did: 2016 年入住时因通道是狭窄单行道只能逐个搬入，六周内全部安顿

facts.snippet: it took many of us to get anywhere, not just the members of OWCH, but the people behind the scenes
facts.did: 收尾处致谢：除 OWCH 成员外还有幕后关键支持者，并建议后来者聘请外部协调人

relations.what: 工作坊当天在酒馆结识的挚友，与 Madeleine 同被 Maria 称为项目最主要的推动者；Shirley 于 2022 年去世
工作坊后打电话促成本群体“真的去做”，是早期核心推动者；2005 年病逝，未能住进 New Ground
Housing for Women 首席执行官，出席工作坊后主动联系 Maria 提供支持，并把同事 Meera Bedi 引进项目
同属世俗犹太移民家庭背景，都被父权社会的期待压制过，后成为并肩的核心推动者
